newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hills sees growth difficult in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hills sees growth difficult in 96/97.

text.p: Consumer products and electronics group Hills Industries Ltd said on Monday the combination of a weak domestic economy and general uncertainties would make growth in its 1996/97 financial year difficult.
The company earlier said its net profit for the year to June 30, 1996 rose 1.5 percent to A$12.22 million.

"The uncertainty in the pay TV market in Australia led to reduced sales opportunities in the second half of the year and created a difficult inventory management situation due to committments made against changing forecast requirements from the key pay TV operators," Hills said.

Hills chairman Bob Ling said the current year had started generally in line with expectations. He said the company's budgets predicted a flat result from its consumer products division offset by some future in electronics.
"The full implications of the uncertainty in the Pay TV market are difficult to determine, however, this situation should become clearer in coming weeks," he said in a statement.
At 1.45 p.m. (0345 GMT), Hills shares were five cents weaker at A$6.90.
